brief.zh: 测试人员收到满8000分优惠的边界投诉。实际调用缺陷与修复函数，以7999、8000等精确金额复现“先取整再判断”的差异，提交可重复的缺陷记录。
brief.en: A tester investigates a discount boundary at 8000 cents. Reproduce rounding-based behavior with exact values and distinguish expected from observed results.

zh: 缺陷步骤能在给定版本重现
en: Reconcile the complete result with the supplied input IDs and values.
Rounding to whole yuan before the boundary test misclassifies an amount below 8000. This is a blocking regression.

failure.zh: 只报告截图而没有输入/版本/预期不能通过复现检查
failure.en: Rounding to whole yuan before the boundary test misclassifies an amount below 8000.

zh: 严重程度与修复优先级
en: Locate the decision and supporting input/result in your deliverables.
Explain remaining uncertainty, your contribution and what the receiving role must verify.

environment.scope: Original small deterministic teaching application; no real enterprise traffic or model inference

zh: 测试人员收到满8000分优惠的边界投诉。实际调用缺陷与修复函数，以7999、8000等精确金额复现“先取整再判断”的差异，提交可重复的缺陷记录。
只报告截图而没有输入/版本/预期不能通过复现检查；先制作能暴露这项错误的最小检查。
逐个核对输入和产物位置，保留修订前后、本人贡献与尚未验证范围。
en: A tester investigates a discount boundary at 8000 cents.
Reproduce this failure first: Rounding to whole yuan before the boundary test misclassifies an amount below 8000.
Check every result ID and preserve a before/after record; explain what this fixture cannot establish.

variants.scope: Fixed reviewed scenario and explicit extension. New constraints require a new review.
